items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: We was playing, uh... That is the old man, Henry Martin.

ctx.x: Paul, Paul. Who did he play with, Peter? Well he played, he used to have a band, Old Man Dorset they call it years ago, they had, he didn't use over three or four pieces then, you know, violin, trumpet and guitar and bass, violin, you know. And how about your brothers, what were their names? Henry, he's a bass player, he's in Oakland. And Charlie, he's a banjo player, you know. He's downtown then, over in the city, you know.
Yeah. How old were you when you started taking an interest in music?
